issues.description: The solution implementation declares the Lecture attributes using snake_case identifiers (e.g., lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students) but the constructor, getters/setters, and the UML/problem statement use camelCase identifiers (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, etc.). This inconsistent naming across the solution and the specification will cause compilation errors and confuses students mapping the UML to the code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier names consistent. Rename the field declarations in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to use camelCase names that match the UML and the rest of the class (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), or alternatively update the constructor and all methods to consistently use the snake_case names. Prefer using camelCase to match Java conventions and the problem statement.
